balance_supply_min_use.description: Set the lower bound on the quantity of its source a `supply` technology must use in each timestep.
balance_supply_min_use.where: source_use_min AND NOT source_use_equals AND base_tech==supply

base_tech.description: Should be the name of one of the abstract base classes, from which some initial parameter defaults will be derived and with which certain base math will be triggered.
base_tech.title: Abstract base technology name.

source_unit.description: Sets the unit of `Source` to either `absolute` (unit: `energy`), `per_area` (unit: `energy/area`), or `per_cap` (unit: `energy/power`). `per_area` uses the `area_use` decision variable to scale the source while `per_cap` uses the `flow_cap` decision variable.
source_unit.title: Source unit

source_use_equals.description: Required amount of carrier removal from the system (e.g., biofuel, coal, rainfall, wind flow). Unit dictated by `source_unit`.
source_use_equals.title: Required sink use.

source_use_min.description: Minimum source use to add a carrier from the system (e.g., biofuel, coal, rainfall, wind flow). Unit dictated by `source_unit`.
source_use_min.title: Minimum bound on source.

area_use.description: The area in space utilised directly (e.g., solar PV panels) or indirectly (e.g., biofuel crops) by a technology.
area_use.title: Area utilisation
area_use.where: (area_use_min OR area_use_max OR area_use_per_flow_cap OR sink_unit==per_area OR source_unit==per_area)

flow_cap.description: A technology's flow capacity, also known as its nominal or nameplate capacity.
flow_cap.title: Technology flow (a.k.a. nominal) capacity

source_use.description: The carrier flow consumed from outside the system boundaries by a `supply` technology.
source_use.title: Source flow use
